question: Can the application's intended users (PSX retail) open genuine short positions?

findings.finding: Ready-market (cash) short selling is tightly restricted on PSX; retail investors generally cannot short shares directly in the ready market
findings.source: https://www.bsl.com.pk/glossary/short-selling (glossary of a licensed PSX brokerage; states 'retail investors generally cannot short shares directly in the ready market' and 'short-selling ... is tightly restricted')

findings.finding: A short-selling mechanism exists via Securities Lending & Borrowing (SLB): NCCPL designated SLB Eligible Securities Category A for short selling effective 2015-05-12
findings.source: NCCPL circular 13-4-2015 (PDF returned HTTP 403; verified from search snippet only)
findings.caveat: participant eligibility for retail / this application's user base could not be verified from accessible authoritative sources

findings.finding: Single-stock deliverable futures can be sold short but with limited eligible contracts and broker-mediated access; not part of this application's execution model
findings.caveat: the application has no futures execution pathway

findings.finding: T+1 settlement makes pre-ownership selling operationally sensitive; blank (short) sales are a closely-controlled, exchange-disclosed exception

verdict: SHORT_ENTRY remains DISABLED (long-only default). The application's assumed short execution model is NOT a verified executable strategy for its users; historical short-side simulation is a theoretical research experiment only.

historical_short_sides.engine_capability: SELL direction preserved for RESEARCH simulation, labeled hypothetical
historical_short_sides.ui: SELL badges now labeled 'SELL·R' (research-only) with policy-driven tooltip

reversal_condition: verified eligibility documentation for the intended account type + an implemented, compliant execution pathway + explicit policy version bump
